lines.en: My footsteps lead me down a familiar path.
I walk and I walk and I walk-
And I look up the entire time.
I see stars.
The thing about the stars, especially on nights like this, is that they make all of our theories almost float away in a sense.
It makes me think-
If there are things this beautiful, anything is possible.
It defies logic.
It defies reason.
Yet, I still believe it while my head is raised.
These aren’t my thoughts.
These are someone else’s thoughts.
Someone who likes stars much more than I do.
To be honest, I don’t really care for them at all.
Or at least, I don’t think I do.
Do I?
Did I?
How did the old Sensei feel about stars?
And did he also have problems wrapping his head around the borderline nonsensical theories that come with them?
How can stars be beautiful?
They’re just lights.
Just splotches of brightness in an otherwise empty sky, getting in the way of where the true beauty lies.
Beauty is buried behind everything.
And so we must filter and push our way through waves of shit in order to get to it.
That’s right.
The stars are shit.
These are my thoughts.
I’m sorry, Maya.
Oh.
That’s strange.
Amidst the sea of stars, I do manage to find something beautiful.
: What...are you doing here?
: I’m on my way to the bar. What are you doing here?
: And what are you wearing?
: What, am I not allowed to wear something different once it gets colder?
: It’s fucking freezing tonight.
: It’s cold but it’s not that cold.
: I’m not...good with cold weather. Makes my skin all tight and dry and shit.
: Your hair is different too.
: Jesus, can I not change anything about the way I fucking look without you commenting on it?!
: Don’t you have somewhere to be?!
: Sorry. I was just thinking that it fits you.
: Course it fuckin’ fits me. Ponytails are boyish or sporty or whatever and I basically just act like a fucking guy, so...
: Sorry for not being out here in a fucking dress.
: You should dress like this more often, Yumi.
: Can’t. Gets too fuckin' hot sometimes and I'm not good with heat either.
: So if you’re not good with the cold or the heat, what are you good with?
: My fists.
: Now beat it.
: Intimidating.
: Are you going to fight me?
: Are you going to leave me alone?
: Probably not now that I’ve run into you.
I take a step closer to Yumi and notice her move back on the bench as soon as I do.
She winces as the feeling of cold wood seeps through her clothing and comes into contact with her back.
I stop moving closer.
I can’t blame her for reacting that way given our...No, my history.
: Do whatever you want. Not like you ever fuckin’ listen to me anyway.
: I won’t stay long. I have a party to get to.
: Party? What kind of person is so lonely that they would invite you to a party?
: Just a few people my age. No one you really know.
Well...technically, she’s met Haruka before. But I’m not about to bring up the cafe again when I already know how upset she was about not getting that job.
: Hah. Yeah right. You hanging out with people your own age? I’m not falling for that.
: How fucking stupid do you think I am?
: ...No, I’m being serious.
: There won’t be a single [teenager] there.
: Holy shit, you actually are being serious, aren’t you?
: What the fuck is going on here?
: I’m not as bad as you-
I cut myself off when I realize that I am as bad as she makes me out to be.
I need to stop saying things like that around Yumi.
: As bad as I what?...Make you out to be?
: Cause, yeah. You kind of are.
: And here I was hoping you wouldn’t have been able to finish that sentence.
: Well how else would it have fucking ended?
: I don’t know. But at least I tried, right?
: Still, though. You and people your own age having a Halloween party? Don’t you think that’s a little out of character?
: Shouldn’t you be at home sniffing your [niece]’s laundry or something?
: I’ll have you know I have not done that even once.
: And what about you? Shouldn’t you be out with Chika trying on Halloween costumes or something?
: I’m not going to wear a fucking Halloween costume. I’m not a kid anymore.
: And Chika is?
: No, but Chika is a fucking popular-ass people-person and does all of that trendy shit.
: Things like that aren’t meant for people like me.
: Besides, don’t even know what the fuck I’d dress up as in the first place.
: Everyone’s probably just going to look slutty as fuck anyway.
Based on how the two costumes I’ve seen so far have been a full suit of armor and a dolphin, I highly doubt that is going to be the case.
: Are you going to come to the party at least?
: Are you?
: I am.
: Then no, I’m good.
: Would you have gone if I told you I wasn’t going?
: Probably not.
: I don’t see why it matters, though.
: Chika would be the only one excited to see me there. Everyone else would probably just feel awkward or scared or some shit.
: Probably. But whose fault is that?
: Oh, definitely mine. I won’t argue with that at all.
: But it’s not like just showing up and being all like, “Hey guys! Happy Halloween!” is going to change anyone’s opinion of me.
: I’ve made my bed and now I’ve gotta fuckin’ lay in it.
: Sure, but isn’t tomorrow also your birthday? Missing out on a party and being alone for your birthday sounds pretty sad, I won’t lie.
: Wh-
: Why do you know about my birthday?!
: Did...Did Chika fucking tell you?! I’ll fucking kill her.
: What’s wrong with me knowing your birthday?
: Afraid I’m going to throw a surprise party for you or something?
: No! I just don’t want you going home and thinking “Wow, I’m getting closer to Yumi! I know her birthday! Maybe she’ll suck me off soon!” or something.
: How are those things connected at all?
: Everything is connected, you fucking moron.
: If you learn something about someone, intentional or not, you’re going to wind up thinking that you’re getting closer to them.
: Then those thoughts fucking snowball and just roll all over any other thoughts you have until the ball gets so fuckin’ big that you feel like you’re a part of it.
: But I don’t wanna be a fuckin’ snowball and I don’t want you to think any more about me than you already do.
: Which is probably a lot because you’re a fucking creep.
: Do you think of me often, Yumi?
: Oh please. The second I start thinking about you for more than five seconds a day, I’m just going to kill myself.
: Afraid of the snowball effect?
: So what if I am?!
: Besides, birthdays are fucking stupid anyway. It’s not like it’s an actual holiday or anything.
: Not everyone wants to be the center of fucking attention. Some people just want to be left alone.
: And I’m assuming you’re one of those people?
: Oh gee, I wonder what gave you that idea?
: It’s not like I literally spend my entire life hiding away from everyone or anything.
: You don’t seem to ever hide away from Futaba.
: Kinda hard to when she’s the size of-
: Yumi.
Yumi decides against finishing her sentence, and I doubt it's because I stopped her.
I’m not sure if she genuinely feels bad or if she’s just holding back because Futaba isn’t around, but I’m glad to see that she’s willing to at least try to contain herself now.
: Habit.
: My bad.
: Don’t apologize to me. Apologize to her.
: Nah. I don’t regret any of the shit I’ve said. I just shouldn’t say as much of it.
: I’d get mad as fuck if someone was always makin’ fun of me.
: But then again, I also wouldn’t just let that shit fly.
: I’d actually do something about it. And she never fucking does anything.
: But there’s no use in talkin’ about someone who ain’t around.
: This party thing you’re going to-
: Is it close to the dorms?
: Not really. Why?
: Just wondering.
She wasn’t planning on asking me to walk her back, was she?
: Are you going to stay out here much longer, Yumi? It’s kind of late, isn’t it?
: Kind of, I guess. I don’t know. Haven’t really thought about it.
: Why do you always seem to be out and about in the middle of the night?
: I could ask you the same fucking question.
: I feel like I can’t go anywhere anymore without you bumping into me like it’s part of some fucking script or something.
: It’s like the fucking city itself keeps trying to force us together and not realizing that I hate your fucking guts.
: You think the city is somehow responsible for all of these chance encounters?
: What else would it be?
: God?
: Fate?
: Neither of those things are real.
: So saying that Kumon-fucking-mi is responsible is as good a guess as any.
: Whatever is responsible, though, I want it to stop.
: I miss all of the peace and quiet I used to get before you started getting all...
: However you are now.
: What do you mean by that?
: If I ask you something really fucking weird, will you promise not to laugh at me?
: It really depends on how weird the question is.
: Any reason you suddenly want to ask?
: Just...something I’ve been wondering.
: But on second thought, it would probably make me sound insane and I probably already look fucking weird being out here alone in the middle of the night.
: So never mind.
: Yumi, just ask-
: Have you, like...
: Lost...some of your memories or something?
: Sensei?...
